title: Seven Keystone Moments in the K-Field Discovery Process

milestones.name: Discovery of the Globally Oriented Cell3 Geometry
milestones.summary: Independent reconstruction methods converged on the same three non-orthogonal plane families and the same rhombohedral Cell3 with a fixed ICRS/J2000.0 orientation.

milestones.name: Recognition that Geometry Is the Primary Physical Substrate
milestones.summary: Cell3 established geometry, rather than mass, force, charge, or energy, as the root object from which physical quantities are derived.

milestones.name: Discovery of the Mass Bridge
milestones.summary: Cell3 face areas generated the mass and electromagnetic branches through one shared carrier geometry, directly linking pure geometry to recognizable physical constants.

milestones.name: Discovery of the Reciprocal Interaction Hierarchy
milestones.summary: The reciprocal metric revealed the ordered interaction structure |I_bc| >> |I_ac| >> |I_ab| and established that reciprocal geometry governs coupling, exchange, propagation, and resistance.

milestones.name: Discovery of the Lucas-Limit Higher-Order Structure
milestones.summary: Shared-face repetition of Cell3 exposed the Lucas limit, the first emergent structure beyond a single cell, revealing hidden polarity and recursive organization.

milestones.name: Discovery of the Seven-Sheet Dynamical System
milestones.summary: The Lucas limit resolved into seven coherent alternating-polarity sheets with coordinated in-plane motion, phase relations, registry, stiffness, and holonomy.

milestones.name: Discovery of Cross-Domain Reconstruction
milestones.summary: Astronomical observations, laboratory anisotropy, sidereal and lunar modulation, oscillator behavior, material interactions, and spherical response analyses reconstructed the same globally oriented Cell3 and seven-sheet framework.
